title: Count Vowels
description: Write a function `vowel_count(text)` that counts the total number of vowels ('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u') in a given string, case-insensitively.
hints: String iteration checks characters one by one against a vowel collection.
Verify whether your check handles uppercase and lowercase vowels equally.
If your check only looks for 'aeiou', letters like 'A' or 'E' will be skipped.
Convert each character with .lower() before testing membership, or include both lowercase and uppercase vowels.
